_help: HOW TO EDIT: each game has a list of items. type is quiz, truefalse, poll, order or content. time is in seconds. For quiz, correct must be copied exactly from one of the options. For truefalse, correct is true or false. For order, write the items in the CORRECT order (phones show them shuffled). For content, timerMinutes is optional. Quiz answers are shuffled automatically. After editing, restart the server. If you break something, the server tells you which game and question.

games.title: Module 1 · Why TikTok: Guess the Number

items.title: Guess before the reveal
items.text: No googling. Go with your gut. The fastest right answer wins the most points.

items.question: How many Malaysian adults (18+) can TikTok ads reach?
How many minutes a day does the average Malaysian spend on TikTok (Android)?
Which platform do the most Malaysians name as their favourite?
A brand needs a lot of followers before its TikTok ads can reach people.

items.title: Phone task: 3 minute scroll audit
items.text: Switch to TikTok and scroll your For You feed. Screenshot the first ad you see. Come back when the timer ends.

items.question: Did the first ad you saw hook you in the first 3 seconds?
options: I didn't notice it was an ad

items.question: What made it work, or fail?
options: A face or result in the first second
Felt like a normal video, not an ad
Looked like a TV ad, so I skipped

items.question: What % of Malaysian online shoppers bought on TikTok Shop in the past 6 months (2026)?
About how many local businesses sell on TikTok Shop Malaysia?

items.title: Phone task: Mystery shopper
items.text: Pick one product with your partner. Search it on TikTok Shop, then on Shopee. Compare price, reviews, vouchers and the product video.

items.question: Where was your product cheaper?
options: Only found it on one of them

items.question: Which listing would make you buy faster?
options: TikTok Shop, the video sold it

items.question: How many TikTok Shop users in Malaysia prefer shopping through LIVE?

items.title: Phone task: LIVE drop-in
items.text: Join any Malaysian TikTok LIVE that is selling right now. Watch for 3 minutes. Note the host's script, pinned product, deals and how they answer comments.

items.question: What did the host use to push the sale?
A shop that never goes LIVE is leaving roughly a third of TikTok Shop sales on the table.
Put the TikTok ad account structure in order, top to bottom.
Where do you set the audience targeting?
Which one is locked after you publish?
Put the A/B test order right: what to test first, then next.
You can edit the losing ad halfway through a split test to save budget.
A split test should run for at least 7 days.
Ad A has a new hook AND a new offer. Ad B has neither. A wins. What did you learn?

items.title: Pair task: Film the A/B test
items.text: With your partner, film two 10 second hooks for the same product. Change ONE thing only. Then show both to the room and we vote.

items.question: Vote, Pair {n}: Which hook stops the scroll?
Across all pairs, what made the biggest difference?

items.title: You are the salesperson
items.text: Each question is a real client brief. Pick the campaign objective you would recommend.

items.question: Renovation contractor in Shah Alam. No website. Wants people to ask for a quote.
options: Lead Generation with an Instant Form
items.correct: Lead Generation with an Instant Form

items.question: New cafe opening in Penang next month. Wants followers and buzz before launch day.
Property developer. New project microsite with Pixel installed. Wants people reading the project page.
Skincare brand already selling on TikTok Shop. Wants more orders this month.
Community Interaction vs Traffic. Which sentence is right?
options: Community Interaction keeps people on TikTok
Community Interaction sends people to the website
Traffic only works with Spark Ads
Traffic is measured by cost per follower
items.correct: Community Interaction keeps people on TikTok

items.question: Your lead gen campaign is live. What should you judge it on?
Client sends a 45 second landscape TV ad and wants to run it on TikTok. You say:
options: Run it, TikTok crops it automatically
Reshoot 9:16, cut to 21 to 34s, hook in 3s
Run it, but only as a Spark Ad
TikTok won't work for this brand
items.correct: Reshoot 9:16, cut to 21 to 34s, hook in 3s

games.title: Module 9 · Why Am I Seeing This Ad?

items.title: Phone task: Why am I seeing this ad?
items.text: Scroll TikTok until you hit an ad. Tap the share or menu button on the ad and open the ad info. See which signals TikTok used on you.

items.question: Which signal did TikTok say it used to show you that ad?
Was that ad actually relevant to you?
Client: "People visited our pricing page but never enquired." Which tool?
Client: "Here is a spreadsheet of our past customers." Which audience?
Client: "Find us more people like our best buyers." Which audience?
Minimum matched users before a Customer File or Lookalike audience can run?
A client with no website can still use Customer File and Lookalike audiences.
It's fine to upload any phone list you bought, as long as the numbers are Malaysian.

items.title: Final round: the whole day in 10 questions
items.text: Speed counts. Top 3 on the podium win.

items.question: Which of these can you NOT advertise on TikTok?
Which platform is still #1 for Malaysian online shoppers?
Roughly how much of TikTok Shop sales now come from LIVE?
When does a brand pay an affiliate creator commission?
Brand wants lots of creators AND 10 hand-picked ones for a launch. Recommend:
How much of ad recall happens in the first 6 seconds of a TikTok ad?
What is a Spark Ad?
options: A creator's organic post run as an ad
An ad that only runs on LIVE
A discount voucher inside TikTok Shop
An ad with a countdown sticker
items.correct: A creator's organic post run as an ad

items.question: Day 3. Cost per result is double. Client says pause it. You:
options: Let it learn. Review at 7 days or 25 results
items.correct: Let it learn. Review at 7 days or 25 results

items.question: Your ad has a very low 2 second view rate. What's the problem?
options: The hook isn't stopping the scroll
items.correct: The hook isn't stopping the scroll

items.question: Which Pixel event tells TikTok someone actually bought?
